notes.title: Jelly In The Dark, Coming Soon!
notes.content:
A survival story of a sweet jelly bear in an ants' kingdom!

Lucky, the jelly bear, finds himself trapped in a warehouse where ants storing their food.
Can he be alive in this dark, full of predators and dangerous place?

You have to know there are so many routes and ways to survive.


A sweet jelly bear in trouble is going to meet you this summer.

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.content:
The direction key/shift key recognition no longer breaks when moving the map.
Fixed a bug where selection was not possible when proceeding with the spider puzzle.
A resolution setting has been added, so you can now play in environments other than 1920x1080 resolution.
Fixed a save/load bug in the village house puzzle.

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.content:
Fixed tree puzzle save/load errors.
After using the village puzzle key, it has been modified so that you can exit the house again Well.
Fixed get stuck issue in some maps.

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.content:
Improved simultaneous input to be recognized properly when moving characters.
Fixed an issue where the initialization did not work properly during the tree puzzle.
Fixed an issue where the option selection was not recognized properly.
